policyBuild.quickstart: variable profile instructions and one appendix page per configured GrapheneOS user profile
policyBuild.credentials: paired blank ordinary credential and account/recovery sheets per configured profile; secrets are completed privately
policyBuild.pageCounts: N configured profiles: 8 + N quickstart sections and 2N + 2 credential sections; generic builds retain 8 and 4 sections. Sections span panels; physical A4 sheet counts are recorded in QA.

formats: A4 office PDF for operator and user editions
216 x 303 mm print PDF with A4 trim and 3 mm bleed
Landscape A4 cut-and-fold PDF for quickstart and credentials; 68 x 100 mm folded slips

foldLayout.printing: single-sided, actual size / 100%; cut solid lines, fold dashed lines with printing inside
foldLayout.groups: quickstart, ordinary credentials and erasure records use separate sheets
